stdout:
Update a caption. Use this tool to update a caption.

Usage:
  yutu caption update [flags]

Examples:
# Publish a draft caption
yutu caption update --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ --isDraft=false
# Update caption language and name
yutu caption update --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ --language en --name English
# Update caption file
yutu caption update --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ --file updated.srt

Flags:
  -a, --audioTrackType string           unknown|primary|commentary|descriptive (default "unknown")
  -f, --file string                     Path to save the caption file
  -h, --help                            help for update
  -A, --isAutoSynced                    Whether YouTube synchronized the caption track to the audio track in the video (default true)
  -C, --isCC                            Whether the track contains closed captions for the deaf and hard of hearing
  -D, --isDraft                         whether the caption track is a draft
  -E, --isEasyReader                    Whether caption track is formatted for 'easy reader'
  -L, --isLarge                         Whether the caption track uses large text for the vision-impaired
  -l, --language string                 Language of the caption track
  -n, --name string                     Name of the caption track
  -b, --onBehalfOf string               ID of the YouTube account that the content owner is acting on behalf of
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -o, --output string                   json|yaml|silent
  -t, --trackKind string                standard|ASR|forced (default "standard")
  -v, --videoId string                  ID of the video
      --yes                             Confirm the operation
